newsitem.title: USA: Officemax gets $500 mln credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Officemax gets $500 mln credit facility.

text.p: OfficeMax Inc said Monday it has arranged a five year, unsecured, $500 million senior revolving credit facility with a group of 23 banks.
The banks are led by Bank of New York, as administrative agent, and Key Bank N.A. as documentation agent, OfficeMax said.
The $500 million facility replaces an existing $100 million bank agreement, it said.

Loan proceeds from the facility will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes, including possible acquisitions and capital expenditures, said OfficeMax's Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, Michael Feuer.
